title: Craft the uncraftable blocks and items
description: You know those things that you have always wanted to craft but are not in the game, well this datapack makes it so that you can.
body:
# **🛠️ Crafting the Impossible Items & Blocks**

This datapack introduces custom crafting recipes, allowing players to craft items and blocks that are typically unobtainable or non-craftable in standard Minecraft gameplay. It's designed to enhance the survival experience by providing legitimate means to acquire rare items.

Features:

Custom Crafting Recipes enables crafting for the following items:
 
- Ancient Debris

- Bedrock
 
- Bell
 
- Blackstone
 
- Brown Mushroom Block
 
- Chainmail Armor (Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots)
 
- Cobweb
 
- Crying Obsidian
 
- Elytra
 
- Ender Pearl
 
- Bottle o' Enchanting (Experience Bottle)
 
- Gilded Blackstone
 
- Enchanted Golden Apple (sometimes refered to as a Notch Apple)
 
- Gold Horse Armor

More might come if they are requested (read bottem on how to contact me about that).

**Crafting examples**

For example to craft bedrock you must use 4 diamond blocks and 5 crying obsidian, and crafting an experiance bottle calls for 3 glass, 1 lapis, and 1 plank of any kind. Also once more the elusive Enchanted Golden Apple is crafted with 8 gold blocks around an apple.

## **Why Use This Datapack:**

**Enhanced Gameplay:** Obtain rare items through survival-friendly methods.

**Balanced Integration:** Recipes are designed to maintain game balance while providing new crafting opportunities.

**Survival Mode Friendly:** All additions are accessible without the need for creative mode or external tools.

**Installation:**

Download the datapack.

Place it into the datapacks folder of your desired Minecraft world.

Reload the world or use  /reload to activate the datapack.

**Compatibility:**

Designed for Minecraft Java Edition.

Compatible with versions 1.21.5 (and up when they come out or are requested

No additional mods or resource packs required.

**Note:**
This datapack does not modify existing game mechanics but adds new crafting recipes to enhance the survival experience.

If you wish to contact me to please contact me on the discord server created for this datapack: https://discord.gg/ejFBf8tm
